entities.summary: Beatus Kinyaiya, O.F.M. Cap. is a Roman Catholic prelate who is the Archbishop of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Dodoma in Tanzania since 2014. Before that, from 2006 until 2014, he was the Bishop of the Catholic Diocese of Mbulu, Tanzania. He was appointed bishop on 22 April 2006 by Pope Benedict XVI.
